text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though both Satono Diamond and Kitasan 
Black missed out on 1st place, the crowd 
was thrilled by their heated battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the stands, Mejiro McQueen and Tokai 
Teio were also watching the race unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black swallow 
their bitter frustration, refusing to let 
things end with this result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, Kitasan Black proposes a rematch at 
the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After consulting with her Trainer, Satono 
Diamond decided to enter the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).
